steps.en: Start the Gaia server (all language toolchains bundled in the image)
steps.zh: 启动 Gaia 服务（镜像里带齐各语言编译器）

steps.en: Write pipeline jobs as plain functions and serve them through the SDK
steps.zh: 把流水线任务写成普通函数，交给 SDK 暴露出去

component.zh: 各语言 SDK（gRPC 插件端）

steps.en: Push the code to a git repo and register it in the Gaia UI
steps.zh: 把代码推到 git 仓库，在 Gaia 网页里登记

steps.en: Clones the repo, compiles the pipeline to a binary, rebuilds on push
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，把流水线编译成二进制，有新提交就重编

steps.en: Runs the binary as a plugin over gRPC, calling jobs in dependency order
steps.zh: 以插件方式经 gRPC 运行它，按依赖顺序调用各任务

steps.en: Streams each job's logs and result status back to the UI
steps.zh: 把每个任务的日志和结果状态回传到网页

value.en: Pipeline logic lives in real code in your own language instead of YAML
value.zh: 流水线逻辑写成你自己语言的真代码，而不是 YAML

sources: https://github.com/gaia-pipeline/gaia#readme (Using docker: docker run -d -p 8080:8080 -v $PWD:/data gaiapipeline/gaia:latest; How does it work: go-plugin over gRPC, clones repo and builds pipeline, rebuild on git push, logs returned; Example Pipelines: sdk.Serve(jobs) in the Go SDK; DependsOn for job order)
